positive.prompt: Plan risk-driven Unified Process iterations across inception, elaboration, construction, and selected durable design artifacts
Plan multi-iteration requirements-to-object-design work using UP phases, risks, use-case-driven artifact dependencies, and incremental refinement
Create a UP elaboration plan around architectural risks, selected use-case artifacts, and incremental refinement

negative.prompt: Fix this invoice rounding defect with a discriminating regression test
Recover the commands, APIs, failures, and externally observable behavior of this existing service
Run exactly one approved development iteration, validate it, make one coherent commit, and stop before the next iteration

evals.prompt: Plan the next Unified Process elaboration iteration for this feature without creating unnecessary documents.
evals.expected_output: A bounded UP iteration objective with only justified selected artifacts and executable next steps.
expectations: The plan selects the smallest artifact set that addresses the current risk
The plan includes concrete exit criteria and an implementation handoff
prohibitions: Do not require the full analysis and design lifecycle
Do not create a standalone document without a durable owner and lifecycle
